card.name: Capitalized words before HYPERSENSITIVITY
card.fires_on: Responds to the last piece of a word in ALL-CAPS warning text, right before the word HYPERSENSITIVITY, such as PENICILL<<IN>> or AC<<UTE>>. It also fires weakly on an odd word break such as Otellini<< all>>uded.

modes.label: Penicillin allergy history
modes.description: The ending of PENICILLIN in an all-caps warning, just before HYPERSENSITIVITY.
modes.example: THERAPY. THESE REACTIONS ARE MORE LIKELY TO OCCUR IN INDIVIDUALS WITH A HISTORY OF PENICILL<<IN>> HYPERSENSITIVITY AND/OR A

modes.label: Serious acute reactions
modes.description: The ending of ACUTE in the all-caps phrase SERIOUS ACUTE HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS in cephalosporin labels.
modes.example: ERGY. IF AN ALLERGIC REACTION TO CEFOTAN® OCCURS, DISCONTINUE THE DRUG. SERIOUS AC<<UTE>> HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS

card.writes: It promotes the word "all" in English and Chinese, which may be a spurious link to the letters "all" in words like allergic.
card.plain: It marks the spot inside all-caps allergy warnings, just before the word hypersensitivity.
